feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 5 June 2026 11:10am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Friday, 05 June 2026 at 11:15am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Transient ridge of high pressure is displaced from the west by a deepening area of low pressure.


##Wind##

South or southwest 4 or 5, increasing 6 in the west, backing southeast 5 to 7 overnight.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, becoming moderate occasionally rough overnight.


##Weather##

Mainly fair to start, then occasional rain or drizzle soon arriving.


##Visibility##

Good, becoming moderate or poor in rain or drizzle.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Southeast 3 to 5, veering west or southwest 4 to 6 in the evening, backing south or southwest 5 to 7 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, building moderate or rough later.


##Weather##

Occasional rain or drizzle becoming isolated for a time.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain or drizzle.
